core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Kawtar corresponds to the Arabic form كوثر (Arabic root ك ث ر (k-th-r); كَوْثَر (Kawthar)). Its core sense is kawthar; abundance; a qur'anic sura and river. Kawtar is Arabic كَوْثَر (Kawthar) 'abundance', a Qur'anic term (the name of a sura and a river in paradise), from the root ك ث ر (k-th-r). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave كوتر (a different form) and glossed the name 'Generous Gift'; the correct form is كَوْثَر. Same name as kausar, kauser, kawsar, kauthar and kawthar.
